brief:
The region enters a critical phase as Israeli threats to target Hamas leaders outside Palestinian territories escalate, according to Shehab Wire. The timing coincides with approaching Israeli elections and mounting political pressure on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

Political tensions at home drive the escalation. Israeli officials have issued warnings against Hamas commanders operating beyond Palestinian areas, even as domestic electoral competition intensifies around Netanyahu's leadership.

title: Netanyahu faces political pressure as Israel threatens Hamas leaders abroad
